parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **PRE**: 预发
- **TEST**: 测试

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-backend-model --backend-id 20bcdc9453524b78a8beb1f6de21edb7 --backend-type OSS --stage-name TEST --backend-model-id 3bb6375bc71c4e4c95ce05b4e7a55a9d --backend-model-data ServiceAddress_:_http://121.40.XX.XX --description modify_plugin_first --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ModifyBackendModel --region cn-hangzhou --Description modify_plugin_first --StageName TEST --BackendId 20bcdc9453524b78a8beb1f6de21edb7 --BackendModelData 'ServiceAddress_:_http://121.40.XX.XX' --BackendType OSS --BackendModelId 3bb6375bc71c4e4c95ce05b4e7a55a9d
